review_notes: I read the whole file. I compared it with the parallel Mathlib/Data/Finsupp/Interval.lean and searched Mathlib for uses of rangeIcc, DFinsupp.singleton, Finset.dfinsupp and DFinsupp.pi. The file already bundles pointwise Icc and singleton as DFinsupp-valued functions (`rangeIcc`, `singleton`). It also provides `Finset.dfinsupp`, `DFinsupp.pi` and the `LocallyFiniteOrder` instance. I found no missing bundled structure that would clearly simplify an existing consumer. The card_Ico, card_Ioc, card_Ioo, card_Iic and card_Iio lemmas are thin wrappers around card_Icc. A bundle would not simplify them. `DFinsupp.singleton` appears to be unused, but that is dead code, not a missing structure, so it is outside this rubric. Any other bundling, such as an order-embedding or equivalence for `Finset.dfinsupp`, would be hypothetical and have no existing consumer.
